title: UAT+Qt: Add dissector syntax line edit
description:
Add a syntax line editor for dissector names, that validates and
provides completion. Use it in the UAT configuration.

It has been impossible to use the UAT to set a dissector with
capital letters; change things so that does work.

This doesn't display the description anywhere, but that would be
nice too.

A better fix for #18836.

added 1 commit
  • e5950303 - UAT+Qt: Add dissector syntax line edit
[Compare with previous version](/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/10148/diffs?diff_id=640587885&start_sha=9b529ec0137da7ac0088372b329dd96840ebe05c)

There's a couple dissectors that use characters in their names that aren't allowed for fields or heuristic dissectors ("application/pkix-cert" and "CI+ SAC message") that the parsing breaks on because of the '/' and '+'

Rather than add those on a case by case basis, I think I'd rather just impose validation on registered dissector names for parsing purposes, similar to what is already done with heuristic dissector names and field names, and then update this (also to get rid of spaces in names). (!10150) With the current situation, someone could again register some name with unhandled characters.

Over 99% of dissectors use a standard name. We also have dissector descriptions now, though they aren't used in many places yet.

Could possibly build on this later in the way that `DisplayFilterCombo` builds on `DisplayFilterEdit` in order to have something that returns the dissector handle as data, uses the description as a tooltip, etc.
Using this (or a combobox version) might be more useful than what is currently shown in DecodeAs too.
